Cleaning Agents: Always use cleaners that match the specific material of your shoes. If the surface loses its original luster after cleaning, we recommend applying a professional shoe polish or gloss restorer.
Daily Cleaning: For routine care, use a soft-bristled brush with water or a small amount of toothpaste to remove surface dust from the outer shell. For light stains on other areas, gently wipe with a soft towel dipped in a small amount of rubbing alcohol.
Color Bleeding Prevention: Protect the color of your shoes. When wearing light or dark-colored shoes, please be mindful of your pants and socks to avoid accidental color bleeding or migration.
Storage & Rotation: When not in use for long periods, insert shoe trees to maintain the original shape. We do not recommend wearing the same pair consecutively; rotating your shoes regularly will keep them in peak condition.

title: Simple Project Origami Double-Layer Drape Knit Cardigan
description:
PRODUCT DETAILS
A slim, cropped knit cardigan with a folded double-layer front that drapes like origami. Raw-edge reverse seams and a deconstructed back give it a quiet grunge edge. Layer it over a tank or tee with wide-leg denim or a pleated skirt for an understated streetwear look.
Material: Merino Wool version: 100% extra-fine 17.5-micron merino wool. Cotton version: 100% fine combed cotton.
Features: Double-layer staggered open front, small rolled stand collar, two knit textures and thicknesses pieced together, raw-edge reverse seams with deconstructed back panels, long ribbed sleeves
Fit: Slim fit, cropped length; women's sizing
Sleeve: Long sleeve
Thickness: Regular weight. The merino wool version is soft and warm for autumn and winter; the cotton version is breathable and easy to wear year-round.
